caption: The drawing features a single hand bell positioned centrally on a plain, light background. The bell consists of two main parts: a large metallic bell-shaped body and a wooden handle. The handle is elongated, rounded at the top, and dark brown in color with lighter highlights suggesting the texture and sheen of polished wood. The bell body is wider at the base and narrows as it approaches the handle, depicted in shades of bronze and gold with subtle shading to indicate the metallic surface and contours. There are two circular ridges near the upper section of the bell, where it meets the handle. The overall composition is simple, with the bell occupying the center of the image and little to no additional detail or objects in the background. The bottom right corner contains a small, handwritten signature and text in dark ink.
title: Town Crier's Bell
